description: iOS执行域矩阵 - 每个未来Capability的执行域分类

IOS_NATIVE.description: iOS原生系统能力 - 直接调用iOS SDK

IOS_SANDBOX.description: iOS沙盒运行时 - 类似Android内嵌Linux(iSH/Alpine)

HOST_INTERNAL.description: 宿主后端能力 - 不通过iOS Adapter
HOST_INTERNAL.note: 这些能力属于Extension Kernel，不通过iOS Platform Adapter

routingRule.ios_native_capability: ToolRegistry → ExecutionPipeline → PermissionBroker → RuntimeBinding(ios_native) → iOS Platform Adapter → iOS Native Provider
routingRule.ios_sandbox_capability: ToolRegistry → ExecutionPipeline → PermissionBroker → RuntimeBinding(ios_sandbox_future) → iOS Platform Adapter → iOS Sandbox Provider → RuntimeHost
